description: Analyze spin density of a gas-phase NO molecule.
user_prompt: Perform spin density analysis on a gas-phase NO molecule in a vacuum box. Determine whether the system has unpaired electrons and report the total magnetic moment of the molecule.

references: Huber & Herzberg, Molecular Spectra and Molecular Structure IV: Constants of Diatomic Molecules, Van Nostrand Reinhold (1979)
NIST Chemistry WebBook, NIST Standard Reference Database 69 (NO, X^2Pi ground state)
method.modeling: Single NO molecule in a cubic vacuum box >= 12 A, Gamma-only. Initialise MAGMOM with both atoms spin-up so ISPIN=2 converges to the S=1/2 doublet.
method.rationale: NO has the experimentally established X^2Pi doublet ground state (11 valence electrons, odd, S=1/2; Huber & Herzberg, NIST WebBook), so the total magnetic moment is fixed at 1.0 uB = 2S by spin multiplicity rather than by any DFT-computed number; this is the scored metric. Per-atom site moments are deliberately not scored: the single unpaired electron sits in the diffuse 2pi* SOMO, and the VASP LORBIT projection integrates only inside each Wigner-Seitz sphere while the pi* density leaks into the interstitial region, so the N/O split is scheme-dependent and has no clean reference value. Tolerance 0.1 uB absorbs the magnetisation-integration noise floor.
